scope: Read-only code review and synthetic peer regression tests. No database, network, raw archive, dump, or actual trial-outcome access in this review.

Canonical sha256=A, bytes=1 plus archive_sha256=A, archive_bytes=true

resolved_findings.after: Rejected with ContractError before pair equality comparison

independent_test_run.command: python -c unittest discovery with src on sys.path, pattern test_science_registry_content_workflow_peer.py

limits: This accepts the parser hardening and exact legacy verification boundary at the recorded workflow hash, not a new source binding or execution receipt.
The exact production origin plan hash is the code's fixed trust anchor; this review did not reread or rehash that actual plan or recertify its source lineage.
No raw source hashes, actual source identity, outcome states, membership, follow-up preparation, or successful dispatch are independently certified here.
The two malformed probes demonstrate parser defects and their fixes; they do not establish substitution in any real pinned source.
Parent-reported full-project validation and fresh v3 preparation are outside this peer test run and are not declared complete by this artifact.
The unchanged legacy verifier behavior was reviewed in code; this rerun covers the 15 independent receipt/parser tests, not every workflow compatibility unit test.
Any further code revision requires review against its new hash before relying on this acceptance for another freeze.
